definitions.explanation: A thin, small branch of a tree or shrub.

examples.japanese: {小枝|こえだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧。
⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{小枝|こえだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くわえて⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: A bird is building a nest with twigs in its beak.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{折|お}れた→折れる：01266_oreru⟧{小枝|こえだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{落|お}ちていた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: Many twigs broken by the wind were scattered on the road.

notes:
{小枝|こえだ} refers to a thin, small branch or twig, the kind that falls from trees or that birds use for nesting. It is a compound of ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small) + ⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧ (branch), following the productive ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ prefix pattern: compare ⟦{小石|こいし}→小石：10005_koishi⟧ (pebble), ⟦{小川|おがわ}→小川：06695_ogawa⟧ (stream).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小枝|こえだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧: to pick up twigs
- {小枝|こえだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れる→折れる：01266_oreru⟧: a twig snaps/breaks
- {小枝|こえだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to gather twigs
- ⟦{枯|か}れた→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧{小枝|こえだ}: dried twigs

RELATED WORDS:

- {大枝|おおえだ}: large branch
- ⟦{枯|か}れ{枝|えだ}→枯れ枝：29824_kareeda⟧: dead branch
